newsitem.title: FINLAND: Finnish bonds follow Bunds lower, eye Greenspan.
newsitem.headline: Finnish bonds follow Bunds lower, eye Greenspan.

text.p: 1330/1030 GMT -- Bonds track Bunds quietly a shade softer and money rates tick up amid some fears of monetary tightening.
Focus on U.S. Fed chairman Alan Greenspan's comments on Tuesday.
Domestic budget talks not seen important. Markka mostly steady.
*FIM-06 yld pct 5.87 vs 5.85 *06 gap over Bund bps 30 vs 29
*FIM-04 yld pct 5.47 vs 5.44 *FIM-99 yld pct 3.79 vs 3.77
*Sept FRAs 3.30 pct vs 3.30 *June FRAs 4.14 pct vs 4.11
Markka bonds traded easier in very quiet early afternoon dealings, keeping a steady 30 basis points gap over Bunds, dealers said.
FRA's were a shade higher, taking their cue from overseas markets but also boosted by creeping domestic suspicions that a key interest rate hike might not be far off, dealers say.

Comments last week from Bank of Finland board member Matti Vanhala had reassured the market that the bank still sees inflation under control, dealers said. "But once autumn comes, a slight fear (of a rate hike) will arise too," one said.
Eyes were on U.S. Federal Reserve chairman Alan Greenspan's testimony on the state of the U.S. economy to the House banking subcommittee later on Tuesday, dealers said.
The markka gained slightly against the mark, and DEM/FIM was seen in a 2.9470-2.9550 range, forex dealers said.
